issue.title: [Auth][Prod] Login provider mismatch breaks sign-in

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

issue.body:
Migrated from $sourceRepo issue #78.

Source issue: https://github.com/ivegamsft/wawkr/issues/78
Original state: CLOSED
Original created: 05/17/2026 23:28:40
Original updated: 05/18/2026 09:25:45

---

## Summary
Production login at `https://wawkr-api.ambitiouspebble-61afd034.eastus2.azurecontainerapps.io/login` is broken/misaligned:
- Google and Apple buttons are shown but fail in production.
- Microsoft org/personal options are missing.
- Email signup option is missing.

## Impact
Users cannot reliably authenticate in production.

## Suspected root cause
- Login UI is hardcoded to Google/Apple and does not reflect actual configured providers.
- Auth config only wires a subset of providers/env names, causing provider mismatch.
- No deployment guardrails validate auth provider configuration before release.

## Repro
1. Open production login URL above.
2. Attempt Google or Apple sign-in.
3. Observe failed auth flow and missing Microsoft/email options.

## Expected
- Login page should render only configured providers from `/api/auth/providers`.
- Microsoft org and personal should be supported when Entra credentials are configured.
- Email sign-up/sign-in should be available when email provider config exists.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Login page dynamically renders provider list from NextAuth.
- [ ] Google/Apple/Microsoft options align with provider configuration.
- [ ] Email sign-up option exists when email provider settings are present.
- [ ] Production deployment includes auth-provider preflight validation.

Original updated: 05/18/2026 09:25:45

---

## Summary
Production login at `https://wawkr-api.ambitiouspebble-61afd034.eastus2.azurecontainerapps.io/login` is broken/misaligned:
- Google and Apple buttons are shown but fail in production.
- Microsoft org/personal options are missing.
- Email signup option is missing.

## Impact
Users cannot reliably authenticate in production.

## Suspected root cause
- Login UI is hardcoded to Google/Apple and does not reflect actual configured providers.
- Auth config only wires a subset of providers/env names, causing provider mismatch.
- No deployment guardrails validate auth provider configuration before release.

## Repro
1. Open production login URL above.
2. Attempt Google or Apple sign-in.
3. Observe failed auth flow and missing Microsoft/email options.

## Expected
- Login page should render only configured providers from `/api/auth/providers`.
- Microsoft org and personal should be supported when Entra credentials are configured.
- Email sign-up/sign-in should be available when email provider config exists.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Login page dynamically renders provider list from NextAuth.
- [ ] Google/Apple/Microsoft options align with provider configuration.
- [ ] Email sign-up option exists when email provider settings are present.
- [ ] Production deployment includes auth-provider preflight validation.

issue.title: [BaseCoat] Exclude generated PWA assets from ESLint scope

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

issue.body:
Migrated from $sourceRepo issue #74.

Source issue: https://github.com/ivegamsft/wawkr/issues/74
Original state: CLOSED
Original created: 05/17/2026 16:37:01
Original updated: 05/18/2026 08:23:45

---

## Summary
Web lint is currently warning-heavy because generated assets (^Gpps/web/public/sw.js, ^Gpps/web/public/workbox-*.js) are included in ESLint runs.

## Why this matters
- Masks actionable warnings in authored source files
- Creates noisy CI output and slower triage
- Violates BaseCoat quality guardrail intent (signal over noise)

## Acceptance Criteria
- ESLint excludes generated service worker/workbox outputs from lint scope
- CI lint output focuses on source files only
- Document generation ownership (next-pwa build artifact) in repo notes

issue.title: Security: Harden IaC ΓÇö Key Vault, RBAC, private networking, and config management
issue.body:
Migrated from $sourceRepo issue #40.

Source issue: https://github.com/ivegamsft/wawkr/issues/40
Original state: CLOSED
Original created: 03/23/2026 02:06:28
Original updated: 03/25/2026 06:47:11

---

## Summary
Security audit of `iac/` revealed critical gaps: plaintext secrets, missing Key Vault, no RBAC assignments, public ingress, and missing resources. All connection strings and configs must be passed as service connections or environment variables sourced from Key Vault ΓÇö never hardcoded.

## ≡ƒö┤ Critical Fixes

### 1. Remove plaintext secrets from container-app.bicep
- Cosmos DB endpoint and database name are stored as inline secret values
- **Fix:** Replace with Key Vault references using `keyVaultUrl` syntax
- All connection strings must come from Key Vault or App Configuration service connections

### 2. Secure the GitHub token in static-web-app.bicep
- `repositoryToken` param is missing `@secure()` decorator
- Visible in deployment logs and ARM outputs
- **Fix:** Add `@secure()` decorator, source from Key Vault

### 3. Remove deployment token output from static-web-app.bicep
- `output deploymentToken` exposes the SWA API key in deployment outputs
- **Fix:** Remove output, store in Key Vault instead

## ≡ƒƒá Security Gaps

### 4. Create Key Vault module (`iac/security/keyvault.bicep`)
- `parameters.bicep` defines `keyVaultName` but no module exists
- Key Vault with RBAC access model (no access policies)
- Private endpoint on the privatelink subnet
- Network ACL denying public access
- Store all secrets: Cosmos endpoint, GitHub token, SWA deploy token, future API keys
- All app config must reference Key Vault secrets, never inline values

### 5. Create RBAC role assignments (`iac/identity/role-assignments.bicep`)
- Managed identity exists but has no role assignments
- Cosmos DB reader role is defined but never assigned
- **Assign:** `Cosmos DB Built-in Data Contributor` to API managed identity
- **Assign:** `Key Vault Secrets User` to API managed identity
- **Assign:** `AcrPull` when ACR is added
- **Assign:** `Storage Blob Data Contributor` when Storage is added

### 6. Make Container App Environment internal
- Currently `internal: false` ΓÇö public access to ingress
- `allowInsecure: true` permits non-TLS traffic
- **Fix:** Set `internal: true`, set `allowInsecure: false`
- Route public traffic through Front Door or Application Gateway

### 7. Create private DNS zone resource (`iac/networking/private-dns.bicep`)
- `private-endpoint.bicep` references a DNS zone by ID but never creates it
- Deployment will fail if the zone doesn't exist
- Create DNS zone and VNet link

## ≡ƒƒí Missing Resources

### 8. Azure Container Registry (`iac/backend/acr.bicep`)
- No ACR for hosting app container images
- Premium SKU (required for private link)
- Private endpoint, admin user disabled, public network access disabled
- Managed identity pulls via AcrPull role

### 9. Front Door or Application Gateway (`iac/networking/front-door.bicep`)
- No ingress gateway ΓÇö API is either fully public or fully internal
- WAF policy for OWASP protection
- SSL termination, rate limiting
- Route to internal Container App Environment

### 10. Storage Account (`iac/data/storage.bicep`)
- Needed for blob uploads (issue #36)
- Private endpoint, RBAC access, firewall rules
- Connection via managed identity, not access keys

### 11. Log Analytics & monitoring (`iac/monitoring/log-analytics.bicep`)
- No diagnostics, Log Analytics, or Application Insights
- Required for telemetry (issue #23)
- Diagnostic settings on all resources

### 12. Main orchestrator (`iac/main.bicep`)
- No top-level file wiring modules together
- Create `main.bicep` composing all modules with parameter flow and dependencies
- Environment variables and service connections flow from Key Vault through main.bicep to consuming modules

## Config Management Principles
- **No secrets in Bicep params or outputs** ΓÇö always Key Vault
- **Connection strings as env vars** ΓÇö sourced from Key Vault references or App Configuration
- **Service connections** ΓÇö use managed identity + RBAC, never access keys
- **@secure() on all sensitive params** ΓÇö prevents logging
- **No public endpoints on data services** ΓÇö private link only

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All secrets stored in and sourced from Key Vault
- [ ] `@secure()` on all sensitive parameters
- [ ] No secrets in deployment outputs
- [ ] RBAC role assignments for all service-to-service auth
- [ ] Container App Environment set to internal
- [ ] Front Door or App Gateway for public ingress with WAF
- [ ] Private endpoints on Cosmos DB, Key Vault, ACR, Storage
- [ ] Private DNS zones created and linked to VNet
- [ ] ACR, Storage Account, and Log Analytics modules added
- [ ] `main.bicep` orchestrates all modules
- [ ] All connection strings passed as env vars from Key Vault

issue.title: Feature: Create bootstrap script for dev environment setup

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

issue.body:
Migrated from $sourceRepo issue #39.

Source issue: https://github.com/ivegamsft/wawkr/issues/39
Original state: CLOSED
Original created: 03/23/2026 01:57:27
Original updated: 03/25/2026 05:28:14

---

## Summary
Create a one-command bootstrap script that sets up a developer's local environment from a fresh clone ΓÇö installing dependencies, configuring environment variables, seeding the database, and verifying everything works.

## Script Behavior

### 1. Prerequisites Check
- Verify Node.js version (>= 18)
- Verify pnpm is installed (install if missing via corepack)
- Verify Git is configured
- Verify Expo CLI is available (prompt to install if missing)
- Print clear error messages for missing prerequisites

### 2. Install Dependencies
- Run `pnpm install` at the monorepo root
- Verify all workspace packages resolve correctly

### 3. Environment Configuration
- Copy `.env.example` ΓåÆ `.env.local` for each app (web, mobile) if not already present
- Prompt for required values or use sensible defaults
- Generate secrets (e.g. `AUTH_SECRET`) automatically

### 4. Database Setup
- Create SQLite database file if it doesn't exist
- Run Drizzle migrations (`pnpm drizzle-kit push`)
- Seed sample data (link to #34)

### 5. Build Shared Packages
- Build `packages/tokens` and `packages/types` so apps can import them

### 6. Verification
- Run `pnpm typecheck` to confirm no type errors
- Start web dev server briefly and verify it responds on localhost
- Print a success summary with next steps

## Script Format
- `scripts/bootstrap.sh` for macOS/Linux
- `scripts/bootstrap.ps1` for Windows
- Add `pnpm bootstrap` script in root `package.json`
- Colorized output with step indicators (Γ£ô / Γ£ù)
- `--skip-seed` flag to skip sample data
- `--ci` flag for non-interactive mode (CI environments)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Single command (`pnpm bootstrap`) sets up the full dev environment
- [ ] Works on macOS, Linux, and Windows
- [ ] Prerequisites are checked with clear error messages
- [ ] .env files are created from examples with sensible defaults
- [ ] Database is created, migrated, and seeded
- [ ] Shared packages are built
- [ ] Verification step confirms the setup works
- [ ] README updated with bootstrap instructions

- Prompt for required values or use sensible defaults
- Generate secrets (e.g. `AUTH_SECRET`) automatically

### 4. Database Setup
- Create SQLite database file if it doesn't exist
- Run Drizzle migrations (`pnpm drizzle-kit push`)
- Seed sample data (link to #34)

### 5. Build Shared Packages
- Build `packages/tokens` and `packages/types` so apps can import them

- Run `pnpm typecheck` to confirm no type errors
- Start web dev server briefly and verify it responds on localhost

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

issue.body:
Migrated from $sourceRepo issue #38.

Source issue: https://github.com/ivegamsft/wawkr/issues/38
Original state: CLOSED
Original created: 03/23/2026 01:09:24
Original updated: 03/25/2026 07:18:37

---

## Summary
Extend the existing Pulse/Midnight theme system into a full skinning engine with multiple visual themes users can select. Each skin defines a complete color palette, typography feel, and optional decorative touches.

## Skins

### 1. 16-Bit
- Retro pixel-art inspired aesthetic
- Saturated, limited color palette (greens, magentas, cyans)
- Pixelated borders/accents, monospace or pixel font option
- Nostalgic CRT-style subtle scan-line overlay (optional)

### 2. Palm Beach
- Warm, tropical, relaxed vibe
- Coral, turquoise, sandy beige, palm green
- Light background with warm accent colors
- Soft rounded shapes, breezy feel

### 3. Forest
- Earthy, nature-inspired
- Deep greens, mossy tones, bark browns, warm amber
- Dark background with organic accent colors
- Muted, calming palette

### 4. Dark Mode
- Clean, modern dark theme
- Neutral grays and blues, high contrast text
- Distinct from Pulse/Midnight ΓÇö more conventional dark mode
- Follows system preference by default

### 5. Light Mode
- Clean, bright light theme
- White/light gray surfaces, dark text
- Accessible contrast ratios throughout
- Follows system preference by default

## Architecture

### Design Tokens (`packages/tokens`)
- Extend token package with a `skins/` directory
- Each skin exports a complete MD3-compatible token set (surface, primary, secondary, error, etc.)
- Tokens consumed by both web (CSS variables / Tailwind config) and mobile (React Native StyleSheet)

### Skin Definition Interface
\\\	ypescript
interface Skin {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  preview: string; // thumbnail URL
  tokens: MD3ColorTokens;
  typography?: { fontFamily?: string; monoFamily?: string; };
  effects?: { scanlines?: boolean; pixelBorders?: boolean; };
  isDark: boolean;
}
\\\`n
### Settings Integration
- Add skin selector to Settings page (web + mobile)
- Show skin preview thumbnails in a grid
- Persist selection to `userSettings.theme` (extend from pulse/midnight to skin IDs)
- System preference detection for dark/light auto-switching

### Runtime Theme Provider
- Web: CSS custom properties updated at root, Tailwind `darkMode: 'class'` strategy
- Mobile: React context provider that maps tokens to StyleSheet values
- Smooth transition when switching skins

### UI Spec Mockups
- Create skin preview cards for the settings screen
- Optional: create one sample screen (e.g. Home) per skin for the design spec

## Migration
- Pulse and Midnight become skins within the new system (backwards compatible)
- Existing `theme: 'pulse' | 'midnight'` setting maps to skin IDs

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Skin definition interface and token structure in `packages/tokens`
- [ ] 5 new skins implemented (16-bit, Palm Beach, Forest, Dark, Light)
- [ ] Pulse and Midnight migrated into the skin system
- [ ] Skin selector in Settings (web + mobile) with preview thumbnails
- [ ] Runtime theme switching without page reload
- [ ] System preference auto-detection for dark/light
- [ ] At least one UI spec mockup per new skin

issue.title: Feature: App store packaging and deployment workflow

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

issue.body:
Migrated from $sourceRepo issue #37.

Source issue: https://github.com/ivegamsft/wawkr/issues/37
Original state: CLOSED
Original created: 03/23/2026 01:07:12
Original updated: 03/25/2026 06:47:23

---

## Summary
Create GitHub Actions workflows to package the WawkR mobile app (Expo/React Native) and deploy to the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

## Workflows

### 1. Build & Package (on tag or manual dispatch)
- Trigger on version tags (`v*.*.*`) or `workflow_dispatch`
- Run `eas build --platform ios` for iOS (.ipa)
- Run `eas build --platform android` for Android (.aab)
- Upload build artifacts to GitHub release
- Notify team on build success/failure (Slack, email, or GitHub comment)

### 2. Submit to App Stores
- Trigger manually or on successful build workflow
- **iOS**: `eas submit --platform ios` to App Store Connect (TestFlight for staging, production release for tags)
- **Android**: `eas submit --platform android` to Google Play Console (internal track for staging, production for tags)
- Support staged rollouts (e.g. 10% ΓåÆ 50% ΓåÆ 100%)

### 3. OTA Updates (non-native changes)
- Trigger on push to `master` when only JS/TS files change
- Run `eas update` to push over-the-air updates
- Channel management: `preview` for staging, `production` for live
- Skip OTA if native code changed (auto-detect via `npx expo-updates` fingerprint)

## Secrets & Configuration
- `EXPO_TOKEN` ΓÇö EAS authentication
- `APPLE_ID`, `ASC_KEY_ID`, `ASC_ISSUER_ID`, `ASC_KEY_P8` ΓÇö App Store Connect API key
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY` ΓÇö Google Play service account JSON
- `KEYSTORE_BASE64`, `KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`, `KEY_ALIAS`, `KEY_PASSWORD` ΓÇö Android signing
- Store all in GitHub Secrets, reference in workflow

## Versioning
- Bump `app.json` version and build number in a pre-release script
- Follow semver: major.minor.patch
- Auto-generate changelog from conventional commits since last tag

## App Store Metadata
- Screenshots generated from UI spec mockups or automated via Detox/Maestro
- Store listing copy (description, keywords, categories) managed in `fastlane/metadata/` or `store/` folder
- Privacy policy and terms URLs configured

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] EAS Build workflow produces iOS and Android binaries on tag push
- [ ] Build artifacts attached to GitHub releases
- [ ] App Store submission workflow deploys to TestFlight and Play internal track
- [ ] OTA update workflow pushes JS-only changes without full rebuild
- [ ] All signing keys and credentials stored securely in GitHub Secrets
- [ ] Version bumping and changelog generation automated
- [ ] README documents the release process

issue.title: Feature: Secure blob upload service

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

issue.body:
Migrated from $sourceRepo issue #36.

Source issue: https://github.com/ivegamsft/wawkr/issues/36
Original state: CLOSED
Original created: 03/23/2026 01:05:37
Original updated: 03/25/2026 06:47:21

---

## Summary
Build a secure, production-grade blob upload service for photos, documents, and media across the app (pet photos, walk photos, walker profile pictures). The existing `POST /api/v1/upload` endpoint stores files locally ΓÇö this needs to be hardened and extended.

## Scope

### Storage Backend
- Abstract storage behind a provider interface (local disk for dev, Azure Blob / S3 for production)
- Configurable via environment variables (`STORAGE_PROVIDER`, `STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING`, `STORAGE_CONTAINER`)
- Organize blobs by type: `pets/`, `walks/`, `profiles/`, `misc/`

### Upload Security
- **File type validation** ΓÇö allowlist of MIME types (image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/heic, application/pdf)
- **File size limits** ΓÇö configurable max size (default 10MB for images, 25MB for documents)
- **Virus/malware scanning** ΓÇö integration point for ClamAV or cloud-based scanning
- **Filename sanitization** ΓÇö strip special characters, generate UUIDs for stored filenames
- **Content-Type verification** ΓÇö validate magic bytes match declared MIME type, not just file extension

### Access Control
- **Signed URLs** ΓÇö generate time-limited signed URLs for blob access (default 1 hour expiry)

issue.title: Feature: Create CI/CD workflows for deployment

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

issue.body:
Migrated from $sourceRepo issue #35.

Source issue: https://github.com/ivegamsft/wawkr/issues/35
Original state: CLOSED
Original created: 03/23/2026 01:05:12
Original updated: 03/25/2026 05:28:13

---

## Summary
Set up GitHub Actions workflows to automate build, test, and deployment for both the web dashboard and mobile app.

## Workflows Needed

### 1. CI ΓÇö Build & Test (on every PR and push to master)
- Install dependencies (pnpm)
- Run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck`
- Run `pnpm build` for all packages and apps
- Run `pnpm test` (web tests)
- Cache node_modules and .next build

### 2. Deploy Web (Next.js)
- Trigger on push to `master` or manual dispatch
- Build the web app
- Deploy to target environment (e.g. Vercel, Azure, Docker)
- Environment variables and secrets management
- Staging vs production environments

### 3. Deploy Mobile (Expo)
- Trigger on push to `master` or manual dispatch
- Run `eas build` for Android and iOS
- Optionally submit to app stores via `eas submit`
- OTA updates via `eas update` for non-native changes

### 4. Docker Build & Push
- Build Docker image using existing `Dockerfile` and `docker-compose.yml`
- Push to container registry (GHCR or ACR)
- Tag with commit SHA and `latest`

## Considerations
- Use pnpm caching for fast CI
- Separate workflows per concern (CI vs deploy)
- Branch protection: require CI pass before merge
- Secrets: API keys, signing certs, deploy tokens stored in GitHub Secrets
- Consider environment-based deployments (dev, staging, prod)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] CI workflow runs lint, typecheck, build, and test on PRs
- [ ] Web deploy workflow builds and deploys on merge to master
- [ ] Mobile deploy workflow triggers EAS build
- [ ] Docker workflow builds and pushes images
- [ ] All workflows use caching for performance

issue.title: Feature: Create sample data pack for testing

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

issue.body:
Migrated from $sourceRepo issue #34.

Source issue: https://github.com/ivegamsft/wawkr/issues/34
Original state: CLOSED
Original created: 03/23/2026 01:04:28
Original updated: 03/25/2026 06:36:54

---

## Summary
Create a comprehensive sample data pack that populates the app with realistic test data across all entities. This makes it easy for developers and testers to exercise the full UI without manual data entry.

## Data to Include
- **Users** ΓÇö 3-5 users with different roles (owner, caretaker, walker, sitter)
- **Pets** ΓÇö 6-8 pets across species (dogs, cats, bird, custom types) with avatars, medical notes, microchip IDs
- **Walks** ΓÇö 15-20 walks in various statuses (planned, active, completed) with routes, events (pee, poop, photo, note), durations, distances
- **Teams** ΓÇö 1-2 teams with members and varied permissions
- **Reminders** ΓÇö Pre-configured reminders (bag, food, water, medication, vet, grooming) across pets
- **Walk Events** ΓÇö Realistic event timelines within walks

## Requirements
- Loadable via a script or API endpoint (e.g. `pnpm seed` or `POST /api/v1/seed`)
- Idempotent ΓÇö safe to run multiple times (clears and re-seeds)
- Realistic names, dates, and relationships
- Cover edge cases: pets with no walks, overdue reminders, completed vs active walks
- Should work with the existing Drizzle + SQLite setup

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Seed script or endpoint exists and is documented
- [ ] All entity types are populated with realistic data
- [ ] Running seed twice does not create duplicates
- [ ] README or inline comments explain how to load sample data

issue.title: Add telemetry and analytics

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

issue.body:
Migrated from $sourceRepo issue #23.

Source issue: https://github.com/ivegamsft/wawkr/issues/23
Original state: CLOSED
Original created: 03/22/2026 23:41:15
Original updated: 03/25/2026 06:36:54

---

## Summary
The app currently has no telemetry or analytics instrumentation. We need to add observability to track usage, performance, and errors across both the mobile (Expo) and web (Next.js) apps.

## Scope
- **Error tracking** ΓÇö capture and report unhandled exceptions and API errors
- **Usage analytics** ΓÇö track key user actions (walks started/completed, pets added, team invites)
- **Performance monitoring** ΓÇö page load times (web), screen render times (mobile), API latency
- **Session tracking** ΓÇö active users, session duration, retention

## Considerations
- Evaluate providers: Sentry (errors), PostHog or Mixpanel (product analytics), OpenTelemetry (traces)
- Must respect user privacy ΓÇö include opt-out mechanism in Settings
- Shared telemetry utilities should live in a new `packages/telemetry` workspace package
- Mobile and web may need platform-specific adapters

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Error tracking integrated in both mobile and web apps
- [ ] Key user events are tracked
- [ ] Performance metrics are collected
- [ ] Privacy opt-out toggle in Settings screen
- [ ] Telemetry package added to `packages/`

  • GHSA-c4j6-fc7j-m34r: Server-side request forgery in applications using WebSocket upgrades
  • GHSA-36qx-fr4f-26g5: Middleware / Proxy bypass in Pages Router applications using i18n
